title: Canonical job posting (ai-jobs v1)
description: One posting from one job board, in one shape, whichever applicant-tracking system (ATS) it came from. Rule: a field the source did not state is null, never guessed. Inferred fields live under 'inferred' and name the rule that produced them, so a reader can tell what the board said from what we concluded.

id.description: provider:board:source_id. Stable across runs; the key every diff uses.

board.description: The board slug exactly as the provider's API takes it (case and spaces preserved).

source_id.description: The provider's own posting id, as a string.

company.description: Display name from companies.csv, not from the board.

company_id.description: Slug of the companies.csv row, or null for a board not on the list.

locations.description: Location strings exactly as the board gave them; one entry per place when the board lists several.

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, only where the board stated a country (SmartRecruiters, Workable, Recruitee do; Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby usually do not).

workplace.description: As stated by the board (Lever workplaceType, Ashby isRemote/workplaceType, SmartRecruiters location.remote). Null when not stated, never inferred from the location text.

posted_at.description: ISO 8601 date or datetime the board published it. Greenhouse's 'updated_at' is NOT a posted date and is stored in updated_at.

description_sha256.description: Hash of the ad text. The text itself is not in this record (it is a copy of the company's ad); it lives in raw/, which is never committed.

inferred.description: Conclusions of ours, each with the rule that made it. Replace the rule version, never edit old records.

title_family.description: Key from data/titles/titles.json, first match wins.

first_seen.description: Date of the first run that saw this id.

last_seen.description: Date of the last run that saw it.

status.description: 'gone' only when the board itself was read successfully and no longer lists the id. A board that failed to load never closes a posting.

source_url.description: The API URL that returned this record.
